explication: RustNet is a cross-platform, per-process network monitor for terminals and automation. An operator or automation process starts the CLI; bootstrap/configuration initializes capture, sandboxing, and runtime workers. Captured packets are queued, parsed, DPI-classified, attributed to processes, enriched with network context, and folded into live connection state. The TUI renders that state, while headless JSON and PCAPNG exporters provide automation and forensic outputs. The graph preserves documented capabilities such as filtering, lifecycle analytics, GeoIP, LAN identity, and optional Kubernetes attribution; some links rely on module documentation because implementations were not fully sampled.
